en-US.description: A desktop gateway that connects AI tools to API providers, subscriptions, and local models.
en-US.longDescription: CONST API provides OpenAI Responses / Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini API interfaces behind one local endpoint. Add API keys, supported subscriptions, or OpenAI-compatible local servers as model channels, connect tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode, and inspect channel health, model availability, usage, and errors. Local use needs no account; the hosted Model Marketplace requires a CONST account.
en-US.name: CONST API
en-US.releaseNotes:
CONST API desktop client release.
The macOS app and DMG are signed with Apple Developer ID, notarized by Apple,
and carry stapled notarization tickets. Windows does not yet include
Authenticode signing. Linux AppImage has no platform package signature.
This release does not include a server container image.

zh-CN.description: 把 AI 工具、API 渠道、账号订阅和本地模型，连接到同一个本地入口。
zh-CN.longDescription: 工具配置一次，在一个桌面应用中管理模型渠道：添加 API Key、受支持的账号订阅或兼容 OpenAI 的本地服务，把 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等工具连接到同一个本地入口，并检查渠道健康、模型可用性、用量和错误。本机使用无需账号；托管模型市场需要登录 CONST 账号。
